data.name: Amendment a
data.summary: For consistency with prior mirikizumab studies, the inclusion criteria [12b] is updated with the following maximum baseline liver enzyme levels: alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) ≤2 x ULN alkaline phosphatase (ALP) ≤1.5 x ULN, and total bilirubin level (TBL) ≤1.5 x ULN. To specify that any participant who experiences serious or severe GI AEs that are consistent with worsening of UC and do not improve with the recommendations for management of intolerable GI symptoms related to tirzepatide will be evaluated for UC disease worsening. To clarify that every symptom-directed examination will also include an examination of the heart, lungs, abdomen, neurological system, thyroid, and visual examination of the skin, consistent with the existing text in the schedule of activities under "Complete Physical Examination." To add acute kidney injury as an AESI to the protocol. To include pregnancy testing every 4 weeks. This can include home urine pregnancy testing. To update that follow-up information for pregnancy outcomes for participant and neonate will be collected until termination of the pregnancy or for at least 12 months post-delivery.
